sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a verified canonical cross-owner association that pairs a structural member load case and its application location/effect with the member-capacity result and supports an explicit paired capacity-minimisation comparison.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate encodes the minimisation requirement only as a presence/true boolean and unconstrained strings. It must faithfully constrain the non-empty comparisonModel: connect the ice-load-patch design case to the relevant structural-member load case and require evidence that the load-patch location is selected where the member capacity under the combined bending-and-shear effect is minimised, rather than merely identifying an effect and a location.
